core_claims.name: productComm / productAssoc / iffProduct / unitLeft / unitRight
core_claims.scope: Full intensional Iso records for product commutation/association, two implications versus a pair of functions, and unit identities, with both inverse laws.

core_claims.name: sumEta / sumUnique / sumComm / sumAssoc / emptyLeft / emptyRight
core_claims.scope: Sum eta and pointwise elimination uniqueness; full Iso records for sum commutation/association and empty identities.

core_claims.name: currying / curryRound / uncurryRound
core_claims.scope: Logical equivalence of curried and pair-consuming functions, with both round trips proved at every argument; no whole-function equality assumption.

core_claims.name: functionSum / functionSumRound / functionSumHandlers / functionProduct / functionProductRound / functionProductHandlers
core_claims.scope: Both function-space distributions have two conversion maps and pointwise recovery for original functions and reconstructed handlers, without function extensionality.

core_claims.name: productSum / sumProduct
core_claims.scope: Full Iso for product distributing over sum; only a retraction Embedding for sum-over-product with a repeated alternative, reflecting extra target values.

core_claims.name: weakDistribution / disjunctToConjunct / noGeneralConverse
core_claims.scope: Weak distribution and disjunct-of-conjunct implication; checked counterexample refuting a general converse instantiated at unit/empty types.

deviations: Uses Idris pair, unit, Either and Void instead of redeclaring duplicate connective datatypes.
The three upstream function-space Iso results are expressed as Iff plus explicit pointwise inverse laws; the extensionality-dependent whole-function equality upgrades are not claimed.
Finite cardinality examples are explained in prose rather than encoded as standalone enumeration functions.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: Recorded separately by the primary editor and independent reviewer
